title: Startup Nights 2026 is comming up on 5-6 Nov. in Switzerland
summary: Startup Nights 2026 is an upcoming startup conference scheduled for November 5-6 in Switzerland, providing a platform for entrepreneurs, investors, and innovators to connect and share ideas.
problem_solved: Connects startups with investors and provides networking opportunities for the European startup ecosystem.
why_valuable: Offers a physical networking hub for founders, investors, and tech professionals in Switzerland and beyond.
